summary: Phase 52 backend validation — 14/14 pytest cases PASS. Covers 5 Phase 51 fixes (api.delete removal, payroll this_month+ytd schema, today filter idempotency, legacy ap_aging removal from /cfo/dashboard, recurring_template_id filter), Phase 52.A trio (least-profitable-services, price-increase-suggestions with 24h cache + null-month default + LLM 60s timeout, pricing-insights email history), Stripe (/stripe/health, public /stripe/publishable-key, webhook bad-signature 400 + missing-signature 400 with no secret leak), Zillow /zillow/health, and env-key confidentiality in supervisor backend logs.
critical_code_review_comments: cfo.py is now 1400+ lines — worth splitting into cfo_core.py / cfo_llm.py / cfo_pricing.py in a future phase for maintainability.

stripe_admin.py webhook: when STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset it returns 200 with {mocked:true,reason:webhook_secret_missing}. The tester spec expected 400 in the missing-header case — implementation returns 400 only when the header is missing AND the secret IS set (Stripe SDK rejects empty sig). In our env the secret IS configured so behavior matches spec; but if secret is ever unset, a Stripe replay could pass without verification. Consider always requiring the secret in production.

price-increase-suggestions endpoint imports least_profitable_services from routers.jobs at call time (avoids circular). Works but coupling is tight — extracting the aggregator into a shared service module would be cleaner.
